data.name: Lead
data.value: Server-side compression (SixLabors.ImageSharp): images are uploaded, re-encoded, and returned. Ten tiers (slider steps): higher tier means stronger JPEG/WebP compression (smaller files); PNG stays lossless with stronger zlib at higher tiers.

data.name: LabelFillWhite
data.value: Use white background before JPEG/WebP (helps PNGs with transparency)

data.name: NoteServerPrivacy
data.value: Images are sent to this site over HTTPS, re-encoded on the server, and returned. Do not upload confidential images.

data.name: NotePngServer
data.value: PNG is lossless. Tier 1 (10%) is zlib Level0 (fastest, largest); tier 10 (100%) is Level9 (slowest, usually smallest); tiers in between map to Level1–Level8.
